response_texts: Falkreath sent a request. They say they have six chicks.
Ah, not five, not seven, but six. A very good sign, yes?
Shall I send someone over right away, then?
No, Ja'zel will go. Hmmm... And he will not hurry. He must arrive a little late.
But why? I'm not sure I understand...
If this one is delayed a little, another will appear and replace one of the chicks... And that will be the real Chick the Chick Trader is looking for!
Oh, are we at that stupid story about how an Egg can be a Chick can be a Chicken or something again?
Oh, but of course. It is a story spun by fish that Sheggorath brought from another river or perhaps downstream, yes? The story shows us what we want... and destroys us.
Do you think it was Ja'bal of Anequina? Did he come to this world with a purpose like Pelinal?
Khajiit told you it was brought in. Ja'bal was no such thing. All he wants is to return to where he came from, yes?
By, by ba ba by, ba ba by, ba-ba baaaaay!
Azurrraaaaah!?
Lalanoah, your music box is restored! Please, cheer up...
Hey... There's no one here...? What's going on?
Let's see this music box at once. Ah, I'm so excited! A remnant of Yelem School!
Hmm... Did you drop it? Several screws are missing and its frame is slightly bent... It certainly suffered a strong shock.
Additionally, its lubricating oil is almost dried up. No other problems than that, though. I can fix it immediately, I have enough materials for it.
Excuse me, Romion, but do you know where is today's Black Horse Courier newspaper? It's not in its usual spot...
Ah, my apologies, I forgot. It's on my work desk.
I see. What are you doing, by the way? Making new weapons?
No, I was asked to repair this music box.
Oh, I see. Well, keep a close eye on him. Sometimes he makes some weird modifications.
I won't do anything like that! I was just a little over-enthusiastic the last time...
There, it's done. Will you come here, please?
What kind of organization is this Stendarr's militia, these Holy Pipers?
It used to be the inquisitorial branch of the Temple of Stendarr, and they were investigating suspected Daedra worshippers...
But they went too far and started torturing the suspects, even going as far as kidnapping people only to torture them.
Must have been the work of Molag Bal. He treats Vigilants of Stendarr like his toys.
That's a gross exaggeration, Ozwald! They contribute greatly to improved public safety in many places.
That's true, I'm sorry. But Stendarr won't let such corruption slide. That god is notoriously harsh with apostates.
From what I could find, Stendarr already cursed the Holy Pipers. They're wearing some kind of headgear to cover their curse...
This looks like something you'd use to squeeze the fruit. What is it even useful for?
I heard it can suppress the curse of Stendarr. I don't know if there's any truth to that.
Well, I know for sure they must be insane.
I heard this woman is a descendant of the family mentioned in the inscription. Do you have any other information about her?
She made her living as a healer in Falkreath. Her husband is a soldier in the Imperial Legion, and they have a daughter together.
Gerhard, her husband, lost his life in some sort of sacrifice and her daughter, Lalanoah, is now under the protection of her husband's friend.
That's an odd coincidence... I've talked to that girl already. My partner here is her guardian, too.
Yes, about that... You should have told me something this important earlier...
It's probably nothing. We won't be able to say they're involved for certain until the inscription is fully understood, right?
Yes, but... Hmm, it's too suspicious, isn't it? I have a bad feeling about this...
If you ask me, you're overthinking this. I believe we're finally getting lucky.
I don't know... I hope my fears are unfounded...
Check the corpse of the beast-possessed soul. See if you can identify the body.
There's an amulet of the Imperial Legion on it... but it's broken. I can't tell heads or tails out of this. What in Oblivion happened here?
I guess he was a prisoner of the Reachmen. They turn their prisoners into monsters...
This is horrible. He should've died rather than become such a monster.
Agreed. But nobody who can choose his own death would end up like this...
What a horrible creature. Is this really that "baby"...?
Yes, this is the "baby". It is adorable how it cries for its mother, no?
Bastard, what are you going to do with it?
That is a secret, no? But you shall see very soon. Now, your mission is over. You are dismissed.
My Lord, you were trapped in the desert of rust and wounds, and bathed in a flood of fire. Yet you remained good.
Even as the Towers of CHIM-EL GHARJYG shattered, you alone were not freed by the fires of hope...
My Lord, o kind-hearted one, where does your true name lie now...?
It was honestly very creepy at first... The newborn's eyes were so hollow. As if she was staring at some innermost darkness of her own...
But that all changed when she took her first steps and called me "dad" for the first time. Now it warms my heart every time she calls me "daddy".
I'm ashamed of myself at the time when I couldn't love my daughter. Maybe that's why all I can think about now is what I can do for her.
I love my daughter Lalanoah. I wonder... is this how love for one's child feels?
After all that happened this one still has nothing. Khajiit only stacks corpses in the name of righteousness and calls it a good deed...
There was no choice... No choice at all and this one could not help it. Khajiit truly did not wish to do this...
Rolly-Polly, Ja'bal the Cat... That is right, it is wonderful. Even if there are those who crush chicks, they are still wonderful.
Those who do not destroy are also wonderful. Everything is wonderful, everything is. For those who know everything is wonderful, all is wonderful.
If everyone knows what is great then everything will be wonderful. But not knowing what is wonderful... then nothing is.
This is all Jazel's idea, all of it. Nothing else, he owns nothing else. This is the only treasure of Ja'zel... This EGG.
There is no Ja'zeri... There is no Ja'zeri... There is no Ja'zeri...
Ja'zeri died. His head was cut off. So now there's only you.
So Ja'zel is alone again...
Correct, you're alone. That's quite normal.
Who are you? And... Ja'zel's neck itches...
Me? I am Orlando, Orlando the Knowledgeable. I know many things. I'm a great guy, aren't I?
You will have trouble moving your head for a while, so be patient. It will join to your neck quite beautifully, you'll see.
But Ja'zel is lonely. He cannot do anything alone...
What a boring cat you are. You poor boy... Then let me tell you a story.
Ja'zel likes stories. What kind of story is it?
It's a story of the Chick Traders who piled up thousands of dead babies in ancient Anequina.
Khajiit does not like scary stories. He cannot sleep then!
No, it's not a scary story. By the time you finish listening to it you'll be able to sleep at any kind of night.
How about you there, hmm? Are you going to listen, too? The story of a night of murders will be painful...
Who are you talking to? Ja'zel is right here...
Oh, it's just an observer. Nothing to worry about.
My poor Ja'zeri, you are not alone... Ja'zel is with you so you will not be missed...
Let us grow up together... and then leave here. Do whatever we want to do...
Ja'zel will grow up... And Ja'zeri will also grow up... Together we will be big and strong...
They say that kind-hearted Dagon once prayed for the people, for this world to never end... But that wish was never granted.
He was deceived by the Greedy Man, and cursed by Alduin. At last, he had no more choice but to destroy to save his people.
All because of Love... This is how Heaven was created.
Oh, wow. It's boiling. It feels good...
Steamy, right? It's going to boil some more. Get ready.
Well, if you boil it even more, it will overload and I won't be able to get it back!
I'll stop if you don't like it. But don't you want to see me wet with steam?
Oh, you are irresistible. Let's go all the way while we're here!
Fine, but you'll be responsible if it overloads, all right?
Well, um...
As Laza once drowned in the Spring... so shall you... in the mud...
Look at these priests, crawling on the ground. Even if they beseech the heavens and kneel on the ground, what more can the gods give?
Look at the earth. There is no greater gift than the grace of Nirn and the life you own. The gods have left everything to the will of every living being.
Foolish Atmorans. Those you destroyed could have saved you...
